doc: Field ambience beds (M2-AUD-05; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). ambience: bed id -> file, volume_db (0: the beds ship at -26 LUFS), bus. The director merges these beds into music.json's ambience table (music.json's rows win on a clash). zones: scene -> the beds that play there by day; once night_flag is set, the night list instead; wind: true adds the wind bed. A zone's beds here apply when music.json's row for the scene names none (no ambience key, or an empty list), so music.json can still override a scene. wind: the wind bed's level follows the zone's wind speed (WeatherClock.zone_wind, game/data/world/zone_weather.json): min_db at or below min_m_s, max_db at or above max_m_s, linear in between. tools/validate_data.py checks every file, bed, scene and flag. arenas (the Lead's 10-30 13:08 item): a battle arena id (game/data/battle/arenas.json) -> the beds BattleAudio plays in its battle in place of the field's, fading over arena_fade_sec; the field's come back when the battle leaves (AudioDirector.release_arena_ambience). An arena with no row keeps the field's beds under the battle. Act II's arenas first; an arena that is the same place as a zone bed uses that bed. encounters (the Lead's 10-30 13:48 item): an encounter id -> the beds its battle plays, tried before its arena's (a set piece whose arena changes: the storm waking at the Choir); pending_encounters lists planned ids combat has not written yet.
